<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="cabinet_with_one_hinged_door">

  <!-- Base cabinet body -->
  <link name="cabinet_body">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.44 0.40 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.44 0.40 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <!-- Approx. density 500 kg/m³ → mass ≈ 68 kg -->
      <mass value="68.0"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia
        ixx="9.45" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
        iyy="9.45" iyz="0.0"
        izz="5.30"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Door -->
  <link name="door">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0  -0.19  0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.44 0.02 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="oak">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.27 0.07 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0  -0.19  0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.44 0.02 0.77"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <!-- Approx. density 500 kg/m³ → mass ≈ 3.4 kg -->
      <mass value="3.4"/>
      <origin xyz="0  -0.19  0.385" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia
        ixx="0.12" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0"
        iyy="0.12" iyz="0.0"
        izz="0.02"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Revolute joint for the door -->
  <joint name="door_hinge" type="revolute">
    <!-- Hinge is on the left vertical edge of the cabinet front -->
    <origin xyz="-0.22 -0.20 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <parent link="cabinet_body"/>
    <child link="door"/>
    <axis xyz="0 0 1"/>
    <limit effort="10.0" velocity="1.0" lower="0.0" upper="1.5708"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.1" friction="0.2"/>
  </joint>

</robot>
